item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Add a “Move to position” command to every item.","mechanism":"Direct numeric placement avoids repeated moves across 40 items.","implementation":"Provide a keyboard-operable button opening a labeled position input accepting integers 1–40. Show the current position. Enter confirms; Escape cancels without changing order. Interpret the number as the final position.","check":"Using only the keyboard, move item 37 to position 4. Verify its final position and that invalid values leave the order unchanged.","risk":"Users may confuse destination positions with insertion boundaries; label the field “Final position.”"},{"action":"Offer placement before or after a named item.","mechanism":"Relative placement lets users choose a destination without counting positions.","implementation":"In the move interface, offer Before/After and a searchable, keyboard-operable destination selector excluding the moving item. Resolve the selected destination by ID after removing the moving item.","check":"Move an item before and after destinations on both sides of its original position; verify exact adjacency.","risk":"Duplicate titles can obscure destinations; include author and current position in option labels."},{"action":"Provide one-step Move up and Move down controls.","mechanism":"Adjacent movement supports small corrections without opening a destination interface.","implementation":"Add native buttons to each item’s keyboard-accessible action menu. Each activation swaps the item with its neighbor through the same reorder operation. Mark unavailable boundary moves disabled.","check":"Move an item upward twice using only the keyboard. Verify two position changes and that moving beyond either boundary is prevented.","risk":"Repeated moves are tedious across 40 items; retain direct placement for long moves."},{"action":"Keep every committed move undoable for the page’s lifetime.","mechanism":"An unbounded page-lifetime history restores prior ordering instead of relying on a disappearing notification.","implementation":"Before each actual reorder, append the ordered ID array to history. Add a persistent keyboard-accessible “Undo last move” button that restores and removes the latest snapshot. Do not expire or cap history while the page remains open.","check":"Perform 100 mixed moves, wait until notifications disappear, then undo all 100. Verify the exact original ID order returns.","risk":"History consumes memory; retain ID arrays rather than full item records."},{"action":"Reorder references without recreating item identities.","mechanism":"Separate stable item data from its display order.","implementation":"Keep records indexed by immutable ID and maintain a separate ordered ID array. Route all move commands and undo through one function that validates the array contains exactly the original 40 IDs, once each. Key rendered items by ID, not position.","check":"After moves and undos, assert identical ID membership, no duplicates, unchanged item data, and preserved per-item interface state.","risk":"Position-based component keys or server updates can accidentally reassign identity; audit both paths."},{"action":"Preserve keyboard focus and announce completed changes.","mechanism":"Stable focus and concise status messages make movement observable without a pointer or visual tracking.","implementation":"Render a semantic ordered list. After a move, focus the moved item’s action button and scroll it into view if necessary. Announce “Title moved to position X of 40” through a polite live region. After undo, announce the restored position and keep focus on Undo while further undo is available.","check":"With keyboard and screen reader, move item 40 to position 1 and undo it. Verify reachable controls, visible focus, and accurate announcements.","risk":"Rerendering may lose focus or repeat announcements; test both explicitly."}],"abstention_reason":""}
